scripts.clean: npm run clean:core && npm run clean:mtproto && npm run clean:telegram && npm run clean:gram-db && npm run clean:gram-ui && npm run clean:agent
scripts.clean:agent: cd agents/gram-browser && (test -d .next && rm -rf .next || true) && (test -d out && rm -rf out || true) && (test -d node_modules/@ton-ai && rm -rf node_modules/@ton-ai || true)
scripts.build:core: cd packages/core && npm install && npm run build && npm pack
scripts.build:mtproto: cd plugins/mtproto && npm install && npm run build && npm pack
scripts.build:telegram: cd plugins/telegram && npm install && npm run build && npm pack
scripts.build:gram-db: cd plugins/gram-db && npm install && npm run build && npm pack
scripts.build:gram-ui: cd plugins/gram-ui && npm install && npm run build && npm pack
scripts.build:agent: cd agents/gram-browser && npm install && npm run build
scripts.copy-packages: mkdir -p agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai && cp packages/core/ton-ai-core-0.2.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'Core package copy skipped' && cp plugins/mtproto/ton-ai-mtproto-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'MTProto package copy skipped' && cp plugins/telegram/ton-ai-telegram-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'Telegram package copy skipped' && cp plugins/gram-db/ton-ai-gram-db-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'GramDb package copy skipped' && cp plugins/gram-ui/ton-ai-gram-ui-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'GramUI package copy skipped'
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build:core && npm run build:mtproto && npm run build:telegram && npm run build:gram-db && npm run build:gram-ui && npm run build:agent && npm run copy-packages
scripts.rebuild:quick: npm run build:core && npm run build:mtproto && npm run build:telegram && npm run build:gram-db && npm run build:gram-ui && npm run copy-packages && cd agents/gram-browser && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run rebuild && npm run start:agent
